ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AB=AC$, $AD$ is the angle bisector of $\triangle ABC$, and $E$ is the midpoint of $AC$. Connect $DE$. If $DE = 3$, then what is the value of $AB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB=AC$ and $AD$ bisects $\angle BAC$, \\
it follows that $D$ is the midpoint of $BC$, \\
and since $E$ is the midpoint of $AC$, \\
it follows that $AB=2DE=\boxed{6}$.
